description: Lists the action types this workspace sets an approval mode for, with its mode for each: ask (a person decides each one), auto_approve or auto_reject, with its risk and who consented to an automatic mode. Refunds and the AI receptionist’s own actions are not among them: each automation that can refund, and the AI receptionist, sets its own. Only an owner or an admin may read them. Read-only.
name: get_approval_settings
title: Read how actions are approved
